rationales.english_leakage: No English words; Irish but wrong verb choice.
rationales.fluency: Copula and 1st-person pronoun are correct but 'ag éisteacht' (listening) is wrong verb.
rationales.grammar: Correct tense and person on 'Tá mé' but verb is wrong; 'ar an siop' is incorrect preposition.

rationales.task_fulfillment: Says 'I am listening to the shop' instead of 'I am going to the shop'.
